draft: We direct readers to read the following discussion of our financial condition and results of operations together with the sections titled Risk Factors and Our Business. This represents a revenue growth of 22.03 percent and a profit after tax growth of 41.18 percent compared to the previous financial year. For Fiscal 2025, we achieved revenue of Rs 39.50 Crores and a profit after tax of Rs 2.55 Crores, compared to revenue of Rs 28.10 Crores and a profit after tax of Rs 1.10 Crores for Fiscal 2024. The detailed factors affecting our operational results and financial condition during these periods are discussed in the remainder of this section.
